cases.command:
set -e
python -c 'import json,shutil,sys; print(json.dumps({"python":sys.version.split()[0],"swig":shutil.which("swig"),"gcc":shutil.which("gcc"),"python_config":shutil.which("python3-config")}))'
swig -python qa_swig.i
gcc -shared -fPIC $(python3-config --includes) qa_swig_wrap.c -o _qa_swig$(python3-config --extension-suffix)
python - <<'QA_SWIG_CHECK'
import qa_swig,json
assert qa_swig.weighted_sum(2,3)==13
assert qa_swig.weighted_sum(-4,7)==13
assert qa_swig.dessert()=="Crème brûlée & 李"
print("QA_SWIG_REAL_EXTENSION",json.dumps({"weighted":qa_swig.weighted_sum(2,3),"unicode":qa_swig.dessert()},ensure_ascii=False))
QA_SWIG_CHECK
